name: Photon Shielding Spectra Dataset
canonical_observable: photon spectral response versus material, energy and depth
limitations: Elemental materials; do not construct concrete spectra by naively weighted-summing elemental spectra.

name: IAEA Photonuclear Data Library PD-2019
limitations: Reaction data are a separate physics layer from XCOM attenuation coefficients.

name: NIST ESTAR Portland Concrete
canonical_observable: collision/radiative/total stopping power, CSDA range, radiation yield
limitations: Portland concrete material 144 from the NIST STAR package.

name: Experimental Low-Energy Broad-Beam Photon Shielding Data
canonical_observable: linear and mass attenuation coefficients with reported uncertainties
limitations: Seven concrete constituents/materials at five photon energies.

name: ISIS RB2000164 Baritic Concrete Neutron Transmission
canonical_observable: transmission and macroscopic removal cross section
limitations: Published validated interval 1 meV–1 keV; sample F unavailable in current downloaded run set.

name: ISIS RB2000209 Standard-Monitor Concrete Transmission
limitations: Conservative 1 meV–1 keV standard-monitor product. Not the custom GEM-derived 1 meV–1 MeV product. Sample thicknesses are not grounded, therefore Sigma(E) must not be calculated from this dataset.

name: IAEA Experimental Nuclear Reaction Data — EXFOR photonuclear MF=3 strict
scientific_role: Experimental photonuclear reaction benchmark for comparison with evaluated PD-2019 and scientifically matched Geant4 reaction physics
limitations: Reaction-specific comparison only. Target Z/A, MT, observable, reference frame, energy domain and uncertainty/status semantics must match. Correlated, dependent, preliminary, approved and renormalized records remain explicitly flagged and must not be treated as statistically independent by default.
